title: The proper factor of compact-support site comparison
statement:
The proper factor of compact-support site comparison. In the fixed scalar presentation of finite constant coefficients and on the ordinary bounded-below derived categories, the specified canonical maps satisfy the following identity:

theorem compactSupportProperFactor (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {Z' Z S' S : Scheme.{u}} {h : Z' ⟶ Z} {p' : Z' ⟶ S'}
    {p : Z ⟶ S} {a : S' ⟶ S} [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    [QuasiCompact p'] [QuasiSeparated p'] (sq : IsPullback p' h a p)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) a).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus A p).app K) ≫
      (mateEquiv
        (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunctionPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p)
        (derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunctionPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p')
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _).symm ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusNatIso
            (upperStarCompIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.w) ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryPlusCompIso _ _).hom).app
        ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Z).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K) ≫
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p').rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
        ((fixedComparisonPullbackPlus A h).inv.app K) =
    (fixedComparisonPullbackPlus A a).inv.app
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).obj K) ≫
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S').mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map
        ((Etale.baseChange (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) sq.flip.toCommSq).app K) ≫
      (fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus A p').app
        ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.obj K)

The direct-image and inverse-image comparisons are those of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], and the open comparison is that of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison].

proof.text: Restrict comparison_square to D+ using faithfulness of the inclusion. Expand the exact derived square using square_exact from the pro-etale path normalization; identify each edge with fixedComparisonPullbackPlus followed by the inverse exact-to-left-derived comparison. Naturality moves those comparisons to a common invertible suffix, which cancels. This gives plus_square, without a direct-image assertion.

The private generic cube theorem transposes under the target adjunction. Apply mateEquiv_counit, naturality of the pullback square and the counit equations of the two comparison mates. The square equation identifies the remaining path. Naturality of the target edge comparison and mateEquiv_counit for the source square finish the equality. No exchange is cancelled. Expand Etale.baseChange using its component API to identify it with the mate of Etale.pullbackSquareComparison. Specialize cube to the four derived pullback/direct-image adjunctions, the two fixed direct-image mates and plus_square.

proof_origin.place: Tags 099R and 0B65; canonical mate calculation in step 4 of lem-amb-compact-support-site-comparison-open, with the existing comparison_square and square_exact normalization restricted to D+.
